basics.name: Zhiang Xie
basics.summary: Research focuses on climatic effects of topography and ice sheets. Independently developed the GREB‑ISM ice-sheet module for paleoclimate simulations, proposing the 'thermal slope effect of ice sheets' and its dynamics.

work.company: Southern University of Science and Technology (SUSTech)

education.institution: Institute of Atmospheric Physics, Chinese Academy of Sciences

projects.title: NSFC Young Scientists Fund: Thermal slope effects of large ice sheets during the Last Glacial Maximum and impacts on surrounding atmospheric circulation
China Postdoctoral Science Foundation (74th General Grant): Simulating the spatiotemporal evolution of Northern Hemisphere ice sheets during late Quaternary deglaciation

honors: First cohort awardee of the Ministry of Education Postdoctoral Global Talent Program
Member, Climate and Environment Committee, China Society for Industrial and Applied Mathematics
